title: Topic Modeling for Short Texts via Optimal Transport-Based Clustering
subcategory: neural short-text topic model with optimal-transport clustering
task: Short-text topic modelling (topics and document-topic proportions)
problem: In short texts, document representations and topic embeddings are hard to separate, so inferred topic proportions are poor.
architecture: EnCOT, a plug-in for NTMs (shown on GloCOM, ETM, ECRTM): documents are clustered with PLM embeddings into global clusters; two OT losses align document-topic vectors with the global cluster centroids and align cluster centroids with topic embeddings; topics are built from word and topic embeddings as in ECRTM.
llm_or_encoder: Pre-trained sentence embeddings (sentence-transformers) for document clustering; ChatGPT for the LLMScore evaluation
key_results: GloCOM-EnCOT, K = 50: GoogleNews Purity 0.613 / NMI 0.848 vs 0.586 / 0.817 for GloCOM; TD 1.0 on all four datasets.
Adding EnCOT to ETM on StackOverflow (K = 50) raises Purity from 0.418 to 0.566 and NMI from 0.28 to 0.415.
strengths: Plug-in loss that improves several different NTMs.
Large gains in document-topic quality (Purity, NMI) with maximal topic diversity.

limitations.text: Cluster centroids are not used at inference time.
Not yet adapted to dynamic, online or streaming topic modelling.
C_V of GloCOM-EnCOT on GoogleNews (0.45) is below GloCOM (0.475) at K = 50, so coherence does not always improve.

notes: G = 30 clusters in the main tables.
